verdict.rationale: Browserbase advertises "30+ ready-made templates" for starting quickly, which partly spares developers from building a scraper from scratch. Nothing in the evidence describes a marketplace of runnable, pre-built scrapers that can be executed as-is; templates appear to be starter code the developer still adapts and deploys. Missing for 10: an actual scraper marketplace, ability to run listed scrapers directly without coding, documentation of what the templates contain or how they run, and independent corroboration.
